'''Cruger Dunn-Flanagan''' (also published as '''Cruger Dunn-Flanagen''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Decipher World Championship]] in November 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|HD Trooper Beats]] and EBO, according to tournament reports by Paul Myers and Justin Warren.<ref name="tr-d3169">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-13-myers-goes-to-freedomcond3169/ myers-goes-to-freedomcon], DeckTech (Paul "lbmyers1" Myers, 13 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-13-myers-goes-to-freedomcond3169/ GitHub Pages].</ref><ref name="tr-d3125">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-28-freedomcon-you-cant-handle-the-toothd3125/ freedomcon-you-cant-handle-the-tooth], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 28 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-28-freedomcon-you-cant-handle-the-toothd3125/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
